hostObservationProvenance.authority: a real local observation of the host's own direct child; establishes NO session

sessionBinding.authority: BOUND_VERIFIED requires a real producer; none exists in this deployment

invariants.noSessionInvariant: when dshSessionId === null the binding is SESSION_UNBOUND even when a valid local host process observation exists
invariants.callerClaimInvariant: a caller-supplied SessionId with no verified producer is SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED, is not read through the Attempt preview as the attempt's session, and its events are not admitted
invariants.hostRecordIdentity: hostRecord.attemptId must equal the requested attemptId; a mismatch raises HOST_RECORD_CONFLICT

S1-B4_matchingHostRecord.note: a matching record cannot mint BOUND_VERIFIED; the classifier has no host input

S1-B5_selfDeclaredTrust.note: an adapter's own evidenceClass is provenance metadata, not authorization

S1-B8_missingSession.detail: the absence is a missing SOURCE, not a claim about what happened

g1bLimitationPreserved: Caller-supplied local host observations remain NOT independent authority-bearing provenance; the Correlator trust limitation is stated on every Preview.
